verdict.rationale: SES receipt rules can be configured with recipient rule sets and actions to store in S3, publish to SNS, invoke Lambda, or send to WorkMail — and a community example confirms using a Lambda function to parse mail and POST it to an HTTP endpoint. However, the evidence never explicitly documents rule matching on recipient patterns/wildcards, and native POST-to-endpoint requires custom Lambda glue rather than a built-in HTTP action. missing for 10: explicit doc evidence of recipient pattern/wildcard matching in receipt rules, and a native webhook/POST action without custom Lambda code.
